blurb: A liquid in a square box with no-slip walls, its lid sliding to the right at speed 1, at Reynolds number 1000 (viscosity 0.001): a primary vortex fills the box and smaller ones sit in the lower corners, the steady state that Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982) tabulated. The liquid's sound speed is 10 (Mach 0.1), so its density stays within a percent.
